content: MK names two sustained treatments of Ibn Turka in a western language: Corbin's study of the Risala-yi Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayan-i Saʿat ("Typologie des spirituels", ch. 3 of En Islam iranien) and Lewisohn's short study of the apologies.
refers_to_primary: Corbin, 'Typologie des spirituels'; Lewisohn, apologies article
